purpose: C.9 Example 7 (incremental slab tiers via spend-measure caps): annual spend crosses all three bands (0-1L @1%, 1-3L @2%, >3L @3%), exercising apply_incremental_bands' fill-order allocation end to end. No thresholds, no fee, no waiver on this card.

assumptions.note: All three slab rules have an empty selector (match every category) and rate 0.01/0.02/0.03 on a whole-rupee spend split (100,000 / 200,000 / remainder), so every band's reward is an exact multiple of a rupee -- zero paisa rounding anywhere, no rounding_estimated flag possible since apply_incremental_bands never runs the ticket-size approximation path at all (it treats each band's pooled spend as one aggregate amount, not an estimate). Because the window is anniversary_year (the whole year pooled into one instance), the month-by-month spend distribution is irrelevant to the band split -- only the annual total matters. Rs0 annual fee, no waiver threshold -- NACV steady-state and Year-1 are identical.

_hand_computation: Annual pooled spend (selector={} matches every category, so all Rs5,00,000 of grocery spend counts): Rs5,00,000.
Fill order = descending priority: slab1 (priority 30, cap band1=Rs1,00,000) > slab2 (priority 20, cap band2=Rs2,00,000) > slab3 (priority 10, uncapped).
Band 3 (slab3, uncapped): all remaining 2,00,000 spend @ 3% = Rs6,000. Remaining = 0.
No thresholds on this card -> milestone_value = 0. No benefits -> benefit_value = 0.
Annual fee = Rs0, no waiver threshold -> fee_paid = 0 in both Year-1 and steady-state (joining_fee also defaults to 0, unset in the fixture).
NACV steady-state = 11,000 - 0 = 11,000. NACV Year-1 = 11,000 - 0 = 11,000 (identical, no fee at all).
